description: This file defines Polymer behaviors related to an accessible menubar component, specifically 'IronMenubarBehavior' and its implementation 'IronMenubarBehaviorImpl'. It includes role attributes, key handling logic, and references to other behaviors.

methods.name: _onUpKey
methods.description: Handles the 'up' arrow key press, focusing the current item.

methods.name: _onDownKey
methods.description: Handles the 'down' arrow key press, focusing the current item.

methods.name: _onKeydown
methods.description: Universal key handler that directs 'up', 'down', 'left', 'right', 'esc' keys appropriately or focuses menu items by character.
